title: pkinative AI Governance Configuration
description: Machine-readable contract governing how AI coding agents may propose issues, contributions, and changes to pkinative. Agents that scan repository configuration on initialization MUST honour this file. See .github/AGENT_RULES.md for the human-and-agent-readable protocol.
anti_goals: a runtime dependency of any kind
a TypeScript implementation of signing, key generation or arithmetic on secret material (Web Crypto only)
certificate path validation, revocation or CMS before the milestone that owns it (ROADMAP.md)
filesystem, network or process access inside the engine
a lenient decoder that guesses at ambiguous encodings instead of refusing them

human_in_the_loop.gate: A human MUST explicitly review, sign off on, and trigger any GitHub issue, comment, PR, or release. The agent's authority ends at producing a local draft plus a compliance report.
human_in_the_loop.identity_integrity: Any issue or PR is published under the human user's GitHub identity. The agent MUST remind the user of their shared responsibility for the content before submission.

compliance_report.description: The structured summary an agent MUST present to the user alongside every draft.

capability_manifest.description: Authoritative project context an agent SHOULD load before proposing changes.
capability_manifest.$comment: on_demand: load lazily by topic. sources are loaded on every task and verify-docs (governance-sources) holds their total under 16 KiB; ecosystem.json is the counts manifest, needed only when a figure or version is touched.

claude_code.description: How the policy is enforced inside a Claude Code session (settings, hook, rules); verify-docs rules agent-config-parity, claude-rules-sync, claude-rules-budget and skills-shape keep these files consistent.

hooks.matcher: Bash and PowerShell — every tool that reaches a shell carries its own matcher, because a hook that is never invoked parses nothing
hooks.scope: whole command, every shell segment, $( ) and backtick bodies, sh/bash/zsh -c, pwsh/powershell -Command, node -e and npx -c payloads; fails closed on unreadable input

claude_code.permissions_deny: Read on generated bulk files (package-lock.json, coverage/**, dist/**, test-output/**, node_modules/**, docs/llms-full.txt, docs/llms-index.json, social images), and the HITL commands above denied once per shell tool — Bash(...) and PowerShell(...) — since a family denied for one and allowed for the other is not denied

rules.scoped: every rule carries paths: (the source applyTo); none loads unconditionally

skills.name: release-audit
skills.purpose: The pre-release audit of CONTRIBUTING.md §Release step 5 and SECURITY.md §In place of an external audit; run by the maintainer, never by the model on its own (disable-model-invocation: true).
